phaseName: Core Apps: Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator
goal: Establish the app-mounting pattern and build four fully functional core apps with local data, proving the pattern later apps reuse.
summary:
Phase 3 (Core Apps: Finder, System Settings, Notes, Calculator) complete. All 5 steps done, both grader recommendations addressed:

**Grader fix 1 — ESLint unused vars**: Added `argsIgnorePattern: '^_'` and `varsIgnorePattern: '^_'` to `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` rule in `eslint.config.js`. The `_appId` parameter in Calculator.tsx, Finder.tsx, Notes.tsx, and SystemSettings.tsx is intentionally unused (satisfies the registry's `ComponentType<{ appId: string }>` contract). `pnpm lint` now exits 0.

**Grader fix 2 — Notes useEffect deps**: Changed dependency array from `[selectedId, selectedNote?.body]` to `[selectedId, selectedNote]` in Notes.tsx:56. This ensures the editor re-syncs whenever the full selectedNote object changes, not just when the body string differs.

**Step 1 — App Registry**: `src/apps/registry.tsx` mapping appId → component with `getAppContent()` and `registerAppContent()`. WindowManager uses it. 3 Vitest tests.

**Step 2 — VFS + Finder**: `src/store/fs.ts` (Zustand+persist, seeded tree, 7 tags, CRUD). `src/apps/finder/Finder.tsx` (sidebar, icon/list/column views, tabs, breadcrumb, context menu CRUD, tags). 11 Playwright tests.

**Step 3 — System Settings**: 6 sidebar panes (General, Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, Sound). Appearance/Reduce Transparency wired to settings store. Wallpaper changes desktop bg. 6 Playwright tests.

**Step 4 — Notes**: `src/store/notes.ts` (4 seed notes, CRUD, search, persisted). `src/apps/notes/Notes.tsx` (sidebar list + editor). 6 Playwright tests including persistence across reload.

**Step 5 — Calculator**: `src/apps/calculator/engine.ts` (pure-function reducer, arithmetic, chained ops, div-by-zero error, floating point rounding). `src/apps/calculator/Calculator.tsx` (button grid + keyboard input). 20 Vitest + 10 Playwright tests.

**Totals**: 67 Vitest tests pass. 71 Playwright e2e tests pass. Build and lint clean.
stepSummaries:
1. App registry + window-content mounting pattern (src/apps/registry.ts) so the shell can launch and render any registered app. [verified]
  2. Virtual filesystem store (src/store/fs.ts) seeded with folders/files; Finder (src/apps/finder/) with sidebar, icon/list/column views, tabs, tags, create/rename/delete. [verified]
  3. System Settings (src/apps/system-settings/): sidebar nav (Appearance, Wallpaper, Desktop & Dock, Network, etc.); controls change desktop behavior via the settings store. [verified]
  4. Notes (src/apps/notes/ + src/store/notes.ts): list + editor, create/edit/delete/search, persisted to localStorage. [verified]
  5. Calculator (src/apps/calculator/): real arithmetic engine + keyboard input; engine unit-tested. [verified]
